description: Every system the mashup has, which game it touches and the milestone that delivers it.

rows.name: dinput8 proxy loader
rows.does: Sekiro loads dinput8.dll from its own folder; ours forwards DirectInput8Create to the system DLL and starts the mod.

rows.name: Log file
rows.does: Writes %LOCALAPPDATA%/AshinaArena/logs/latest.log, the oracle for every test.

rows.name: Clone Drone locator
rows.does: Finds the player's Clone Drone install through Steam's library folders (app 597170) or ASHINA_ARENA_CLONEDRONE_DIR.

rows.name: Arena option on the title screen
rows.does: Adds 'Arena' to the title menu; picking it loads the arena save slot and starts round 1.

rows.name: Closed arena
rows.does: Places Wolf in the arena area and keeps him inside its bounds.

rows.name: Endless round director
rows.does: Spawns each round's enemies from the rounds and enemies sheets, detects round clear and player death.

rows.name: High score
rows.does: Saves the best round reached to %LOCALAPPDATA%/AshinaArena/highscore.json.

rows.name: Arena overlay
rows.does: Draws round number, high score, the upgrade picker and the 'Clone Drone not found' notice.

rows.name: Upgrade pick between rounds
rows.does: Offers 3 random rows of the upgrades sheet with Clone Drone's own names and icons; applies the chosen one.

rows.name: Clone Drone asset reader
rows.does: Reads Clone Drone's Unity data files from the player's install and extracts the audio, text and icons the sounds and upgrades sheets name.

rows.name: Commentator and music playback
rows.does: Plays the sounds sheet's Clone Drone lines on round events, and its arena music during rounds.
